lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ce2Al4Pb2 (CeAl2Pb) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 38), with 8 atoms per unit cell distributed over 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Al centers in tetrahedral environments coordinated by four Ce atoms, while Ce is surrounded by 8 Al neighbors and Pb by 4 Ce neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph is 3-dimensional and fully connected across all 8 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis indicates corner-sharing between Al tetrahedra and corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Ce 8-vertex and Al tetrahedral polyhedra.
